sl1_boot_2.text: Wake acquisition is live. Close on a moving vehicle and hold its line. The cleaner your position, the harder this unit works.

sl1_boot_3.text: Slipstream units recognise one another. Take a wake, and its owner will know. When someone takes yours, so will you.

sl1_boot_4.text: Eddywright. Let someone else break the air.

voice: male, middle-aged, low pitch, british accent
